title: Hearty Smoked Peruvian Smoked Mackerel Ceviche
description: A salty and velvety Peruvian dish featuring smoked mackerel, this recipe is perfect for those looking for a festive and flavorful meal. It is also ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly, making it a great option for those following this diet.
instructions: Poach the smoked mackerel in water at 180 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
Drain the water and let the mackerel cool.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled mackerel, lime juice, mixed greens, red onion, ají amarillo pepper, and coriander.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the mixture a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional coriander if desired.
Consider serving with corn or sweet potato for a more filling meal.
